project.title: Cloudy Ninja
project.tagline: Heal a broken world, one cloud at a time.
project.description: Cloudy Ninja is a momentum-based 2D pixel-art platformer about restoring corrupted ecosystems. Players switch between three characters — each with a distinct ability tied to the water cycle — across hand-crafted levels that double as light interactive science lessons. Eight stages culminate in a multi-phase Storm Sentinel boss arena, and the in-game Cloud Atlas pulls from real NOAA and NASA sources so every entry is grounded climate education, not flavor text.
project.history: Cloudy Ninja began as a solo experiment in mid-2025 to combine Celeste-style precision movement with a non-violent objective: restore the level instead of fighting through it. The project is built in libGDX (Kotlin) with an open AI-assisted development pipeline. Sprint D (early-2026) brought the game to ship-ready alpha: seven playable levels, a Storm Sentinel boss, 12 achievements, Cloud Atlas climate codex, 4K / HiDPI scaling, full key/button rebinding, and an Assist Mode for motor accessibility. v1.0 ships with the current three-character × three-world scope; World 4 and Character 4 are planned as a free v1.1 update.
project.price: USD 2.99–4.99 (premium one-time purchase, no IAP, no ads)

features.feature: Three switchable characters — Ebo (Seed Slam), Laya (Wind Dash), Zephyr (Float) — chainable mid-jump.
8 levels plus a three-phase Storm Sentinel boss encounter.
12 achievements, all unlockable in Assist Mode.
Cloud Atlas: in-game climate codex sourced from real NOAA / NASA research.
Accessibility-first: color-blind palette, reduced motion, full key/button rebinding, gamepad support, 4K / HiDPI scaling.
Assist Mode: invincibility, infinite spirit charges, and a slow-speed slider.
Three save slots with checkpoint autosave and time-trial best times.
Mobile two-thumb HUD plus desktop keyboard / gamepad.
